WITH circuit_rounds AS (
  SELECT 
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    AVG(r.round) as avg_round
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(avg_round) as country_avg_round
  FROM circuit_rounds
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT 
  cr.circuitId,
  cr.country,
  cr.avg_round,
  cr.avg_round - ca.country_avg_round as round_diff
FROM circuit_rounds cr
INNER JOIN country_averages ca ON cr.country = ca.country
ORDER BY CASE WHEN cr.avg_round - ca.country_avg_round IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 
         cr.avg_round - ca.country_avg_round DESC
LIMIT 10
